findings.label: d/g69ea5c05d859-14
findings.reason: The change updates the BASELINE from 0.15.0 to 1.0.0, contradicting the recorded decision to defer flipping the writer default to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 is published.
findings.text:
Defer flipping the writer default to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 is published.
§8.2 requires readers to refuse a version absent from their list. Flipping the writer before 0.14 is in the field would make every other implementation reject the output.

findings.label: d/g69ea5c05d859-15
findings.reason: The change updates the BASELINE from 0.15.0 to 1.0.0, contradicting the recorded decision not to add version lists to python/, nodejs/, go/ implementations.
findings.text:
Do not add version lists to python/, nodejs/, go/ implementations.
All three read CBOR only and the wire carries no version string, so no surface parser ever sees a @doc header there. The migration plan's assumption was wrong.

findings.label: d/g69ea5c05d859-4
findings.reason: The change updates the BASELINE from 0.15.0 to 1.0.0, contradicting the recorded decision to implement a custom Default for ParseOutcome that sets format_version to FORMAT_VERSION_DEFAULT.
findings.text:
Implement a custom Default for ParseOutcome that sets format_version to FORMAT_VERSION_DEFAULT.
A derived Default would produce an empty version, which would become an invalid empty @doc header. The CBOR path has no wire version, so the honest default is the current emit version.
